description: 2026 take-home pay (or 2027 with year=2027; QC 2027 pending) for a Canadian employee on regular salary: CPP/QPP (incl. second-ceiling CPP2/QPP2), EI (and QPIP for Quebec), federal and provincial income tax withheld, net pay per year and per pay period. Assumes a full-year employee with basic TD1 claims. Supported: all 13 Canadian provinces/territories.

pay_frequency.description: Pay frequency for the per-period view (default biweekly)

year.description: Tax year (default 2026). 2027 uses CRA's January 2027 T4127 formulas; not available for QC until Revenu Québec publishes its 2027 guide

name: employee_take_home
